request.style: English, solemn female solo voice with cathedral choir, harp, strings, French horn, organ, 70 BPM, majestic and reflective
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They died in faith but not received
The promise stayed unseen in view
They saw it from a far away place
Welcoming the hope so new

[Verse]
Confessing they were strangers here
Sojourners upon the earth
No opportunity to return
For the land they left first

[Chorus]
Looking for a homeland true
Longing for a better country
A heavenly place prepared
For God has not disowned them

[Verse]
If they thought of the land they left
They would have had chance to go back
But as it is they long ahead
For the city God has made

[Chorus]
Looking for a homeland true
Longing for a better country
A heavenly place prepared
For God has not disowned them

[Bridge]
He prepared a city for them
God is not ashamed to claim them
Architect and builder of their home
Foundations laid by His name

[Chorus]
Looking for a homeland true
Longing for a better country
A heavenly place prepared
For God has not disowned them

[Outro]
Strangers and sojourners still
Waiting for the city to come
